notes.title: STUNT BIKE EXTREME OUT NOW!
notes.content:
The Launch Is Finally Here

We're beyond excited to start a new chapter for Stunt Bike Extreme on Steam! Stunt Bike Extreme has gained amazing support and love as a mobile game, and now we are proud to share that joy with PC players!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3212130/Stunt_Bike_Extreme/


Features

 400+ Levels and more with regular updates so you always have ramps to jump and stunts to land!
 10+ Environments Take you from bustling cities to creepy swamps to test your skills in every environment
 Bonus Tracks for the most Extreme Stunt Bike masters!
 10+ Bikes with Customization To pick the right bike for the right job, or level up your favorite and dominate the tracks with it!
 50+ Character Customization Options to perform your driving with your own look
 Controller Support


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292738/e1094ff35e495d7faf6786f5fae699dea51a1438.png


What To Expect?
Feedback from demo has been invaluable to make Stunt Bike Extreme a great experience, and implementing feedback into our patches and updates will always be a priority. Expect regular fixes, updates and answers to feedback!
If you face issues or want to report a bug, the most direct and effective way is to email us at support.stunt@hyperkani.com

Other Ways To Connect
To chat with fellow Stunt Bike Fans and sometimes the Hyperkani Team, join our Discord
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292738/4a73534f40e28591c9ab466f56117c4ff0a4f98a.png

You can also get your Stunt Bike Extreme news in our social media

 Facebook
 Instagram

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292738/dab98425b00127c3e062497bb8e1e2bb4490dbb6.png


Want To Share Your Opinion On Stunt Bike Extreme? Leave A Review!
Leaving a review on Steam is a massive help. It directly helps us by sharing your critical feedback. It also brings more eyes to our game, and more feedback!

Thank You For Your Support!
- The Hyperkani Team
